epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack startup time from >15 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml at the repository root to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for stack verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for local stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker setup for this epic, I want to define a compose file, so that the stack can be run locally with one command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When running docker-compose up, Then the backend and frontend start successfully.
Given the running stack, When curling the health-check, Then it returns a 200 OK status.
slices.tocConstraintRef: local environment start and health verification
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce container build and run time from >5 mins to <30 seconds

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to correct an outdated protocol from >2 hours to <5 mins
requirements: R1: Add UI controls for updating existing materials
R2: Add UI controls for deleting existing materials

slices.title: Implement material update and delete UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete UI for this epic, I want to connect the frontend to existing endpoints, so that users can manage materials.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user clicks edit and saves, Then a PUT request is made and the UI updates.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete, Then a DELETE request is made and the material disappears from the UI.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce UI task completion time from >10 mins manual API call to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: decrease unauthorized access incidents from >5 per week to 0 per week
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to catalog and material creation endpoints
R2: Redirect unauthenticated users to a login prompt in the UI

slices.title: Implement authentication guard for catalog and materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication mechanism for this epic, I want to guard the catalog routes, so that only authenticated users can access them.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they access the catalog, Then they are redirected to a login prompt.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then the action is blocked.
slices.tocConstraintRef: catalog route and API endpoint access guard
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated endpoint access success rate from 100% to 0%
